lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are arranged in approximately four horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, forming an irregular 2D grid with increasing spatial distribution toward the posterior flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows, creating local intensity maxima at the intersection points across the mid-flank region.
